question.wording: Was the taxpayer (or spouse) an eligible educator in 2025 — a K-12 teacher, instructor, counselor, principal or aide who worked in a school for at least 900 hours during a school year?

default.because: A client who records educator expenses is an eligible educator unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: An eligible educator is a kindergarten through grade 12 teacher, instructor, counselor, principal, or aide who worked in a school for at least 900 hours during a school year.
